init_configs_AllScAIPConfigs: use init_configs to create an AllScAIPConfigs dataclass from a flat dictionary of kwargs
init_configs_nested_dataclass: use init_configs to recursively initialize nested dataclass config objects from a single kwargs dict
resolve_type_hint_forward_ref: use resolve_type_hint to resolve a string forward reference type hint to its actual class object
create_GlobalConfigs: create a GlobalConfigs dataclass to set model hyperparameters like hidden_size, num_layers, and activation function
create_MolecularGraphConfigs: create a MolecularGraphConfigs dataclass to configure graph construction parameters like max_atoms, knn_k, and distance_function
